headline: Fourth Partner Energy secures ₹750 crore from Tata Capital
hook: New funding for hybrid renewable energy project
summary: Fourth Partner Energy has raised ₹750 crore in financing from Tata Capital to develop a hybrid renewable energy project in Maharashtra. The project includes 300 MWp of solar capacity, 50 MW of wind power, and a 750 MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS). This investment supports the expansion of large-scale renewable infrastructure in India.
why_it_matters: Boosts renewable energy infrastructure capacity in Maharashtra.
winners_losers: Fourth Partner Energy gains / Renewable sector grows

headline: RBI rate hike expectations divide impact between banks and NBFCs
hook: Margin pressure meets asset repricing advantages
summary: The Reserve Bank of India is expected to raise interest rates for the first time in three years, impacting financial institutions differently. Higher funding costs are likely to squeeze profit margins for non-banking financial companies. Meanwhile, lenders with floating-rate assets and strong liquidity positions stand to benefit from the shifting rate cycle. Brokerages have highlighted selective institutional favorites including HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Bajaj Finance, and Tata Capital.
whats_next: RBI monetary policy committee rate decision meeting
why_it_matters: Select lenders gain while NBFC margins face pressure.
winners_losers: Floating-rate lenders gain / NBFC margins hurt

headline: Nomura forecasts rising cost of funds for Bajaj Finance, Tata Capital, LT Finance and SHFL
hook: Cost of funds rise pressures NBFC margins
summary: Nomura expects a 50-60 bps hike in cost of funds starting October 2026 for major NBFCs including Bajaj Finance, Tata Capital, LT Finance, and SHFL. Non-banking financial companies are projected to delay passing these increased costs to end-customers until FY28. This margin squeeze affects profitability for lenders over the medium term. Indian retail investors holding NBFC stocks should watch for margin compression in upcoming quarters.
whats_next: October 2026 cost of funds hike timeline
why_it_matters: NBFC profit margins face a squeeze until FY28.
winners_losers: Bank lenders gain / NBFC margins hurt
